summary.text: James Manning is a Democratic, Working Families Party and Independent Party of Oregon state senator from Oregon Senate District 7 who has served since January 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: James Manning grew up in St. Louis, Missouri, and served in the U.S. Army from 1983 to 2007.
His career experience includes working with nonprofits and as an adjunct professor.
Manning ran unsuccessfully for Oregon House District 14 before being appointed to the Senate, where he assumed office on January 2, 2017, succeeding Chris Edwards.
In January 2023 he was elected Senate president pro tempore, replacing Peter Courtney.

In the 2023-2024 session, he served on the Human Services, Mental Health and Recovery Committee, the Judiciary and Ballot Measure 110 Implementation Committee, the Senate Rules Committee and the Veterans and Emergency Preparedness Committee.
